sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Post-war reconstruction boom accelerates
geopolitical_news.summary: Oil revenues fund a building frenzy in Luanda four years after the civil war's end.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cabinda peace memorandum signed
geopolitical_news.summary: An August deal with a FLEC faction aims to end the separatist insurgency in the oil-rich enclave.

sport.headline: Angola debut at the World Cup
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras draw with Mexico and Iran on their first appearance at Germany 2006.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dos Santos promises 2008 elections
geopolitical_news.summary: The president commits to Angola's first parliamentary vote since 1992.

geopolitical_news.headline: Oil output surges toward African record
geopolitical_news.summary: New offshore fields push Angola close to overtaking Nigeria as the continent's top producer.

sport.headline: Angola qualify for 2008 AFCON
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras book a place at the Ghana tournament with a game to spare.

geopolitical_news.headline: MPLA wins first post-war election
geopolitical_news.summary: The ruling party takes September's parliamentary vote in a landslide, extending dos Santos's rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: Angola becomes Africa's top oil producer
geopolitical_news.summary: Surging output briefly lifts Angola past Nigeria as the continent's biggest crude producer.

sport.headline: Angola reach AFCON quarterfinals
sport.summary: The hosts-to-be lose 2-1 to Egypt in the last eight at the 2008 tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: New constitution drafted
geopolitical_news.summary: A constitutional commission proposes scrapping direct presidential elections, entrenching dos Santos.

geopolitical_news.headline: Oil price crash tests economy
geopolitical_news.summary: The global slump exposes Angola's dependence on crude, forcing budget cuts.

sport.headline: Angola prepare to host 2010 AFCON
sport.summary: Stadium construction races ahead of January's tournament, the country's biggest sporting event.

geopolitical_news.headline: Togo team bus attacked in Cabinda
geopolitical_news.summary: Separatist gunmen kill three in January; Togo withdraws from the Africa Cup of Nations.

geopolitical_news.headline: New constitution adopted
geopolitical_news.summary: February's charter abolishes direct presidential elections, keeping dos Santos in power.

sport.headline: Angola host AFCON, reach quarterfinals
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras thrill home fans before a 1-0 quarterfinal defeat to Ghana.

geopolitical_news.headline: Youth protests challenge dos Santos
geopolitical_news.summary: Arab Spring-inspired demonstrations in Luanda are met with a heavy police crackdown.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition alleges repression
geopolitical_news.summary: Activists accuse the regime of abductions and violence ahead of the 2012 vote.

sport.headline: Angola fail to reach 2012 AFCON
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras miss out on the Gabon-Equatorial Guinea tournament after a poor qualifying run.

geopolitical_news.headline: MPLA wins election, dos Santos stays
geopolitical_news.summary: The ruling party takes August's vote, though the opposition makes gains in Luanda.

geopolitical_news.headline: Succession speculation grows
geopolitical_news.summary: Dos Santos, in power since 1979, faces quiet questions about his eventual replacement.

sport.headline: Angolan women debut in Olympic basketball
sport.summary: Angola's women's team compete at London 2012, the country's first Olympic basketball appearance.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dos Santos tightens grip on power
geopolitical_news.summary: The president reshuffles the security apparatus as succession talk intensifies.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cabinda insurgency simmers
geopolitical_news.summary: Low-level separatist attacks continue in the oil enclave despite the 2006 peace deal.

sport.headline: Angola exit AFCON at group stage
sport.summary: A final-day defeat to Cape Verde ends Angola's 2013 campaign in South Africa.

geopolitical_news.headline: Angola wins UN Security Council seat
geopolitical_news.summary: Luanda is elected to a non-permanent seat for 2015-2016 in October.

geopolitical_news.headline: Oil price collapse hits economy
geopolitical_news.summary: Crude's late-year plunge triggers currency falls and spending cuts.

sport.headline: Angola miss 2014 World Cup
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras fall short in qualifying for Brazil 2014.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly crackdown on religious sect
geopolitical_news.summary: A police raid on the Kalupeteka sect in April kills an unknown number of followers.

geopolitical_news.headline: Activists jailed for 'rebellion'
geopolitical_news.summary: Seventeen young activists are imprisoned after discussing democracy at a book club.

sport.headline: Angola miss 2015 AFCON
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras fail to qualify for the Equatorial Guinea tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dos Santos says he will step down
geopolitical_news.summary: The president announces in March that he will leave office in 2018.

geopolitical_news.headline: Isabel dos Santos named Sonangol chair
geopolitical_news.summary: The president's daughter takes over the state oil company in June, drawing nepotism charges.

sport.headline: Angola's women compete in Olympic handball
sport.summary: The women's handball team represent Angola at the Rio 2016 Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lourenco succeeds dos Santos
geopolitical_news.summary: Joao Lourenco wins August's election and is inaugurated in September, ending 38 years of dos Santos rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: New president purges old guard
geopolitical_news.summary: Lourenco swiftly removes dos Santos allies from Sonangol, the army and state media.

sport.headline: Angola miss 2017 AFCON
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras again fail to qualify for the Africa Cup of Nations.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dos Santos's son charged with fraud
geopolitical_news.summary: Jose Filomeno dos Santos is charged in September over the sovereign wealth fund.

geopolitical_news.headline: Anti-corruption drive widens
geopolitical_news.summary: Lourenco's campaign targets the business empire built under his predecessor.

sport.headline: Angola miss 2018 World Cup
sport.summary: Another qualifying campaign ends without a place at Russia 2018.

geopolitical_news.headline: Isabel dos Santos faces corruption charges
geopolitical_news.summary: Angolan prosecutors freeze the billionaire's assets in December over alleged embezzlement.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lourenco's reforms meet resistance
geopolitical_news.summary: Economic liberalization struggles against entrenched interests and falling oil prices.

sport.headline: Angola return to AFCON
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras qualify for Egypt 2019 but exit at the group stage.

geopolitical_news.headline: Luanda Leaks expose dos Santos wealth
geopolitical_news.summary: January's document leak details how the ex-president's daughter built a vast fortune.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID-19 batters oil economy
geopolitical_news.summary: The pandemic and crude price crash push Angola into a fifth year of recession.

sport.headline: Football halted by pandemic
sport.summary: Angola's leagues and qualifiers are suspended for months amid COVID-19.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition unites ahead of 2022 vote
geopolitical_news.summary: UNITA-led coalition mounts the strongest challenge to MPLA rule in decades.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economic hardship fuels discontent
geopolitical_news.summary: Inflation and unemployment erode support for the ruling party in the cities.

sport.headline: Angola qualify for 2021 AFCON
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras reach the Cameroon tournament but exit in the group stage.

geopolitical_news.headline: MPLA wins closest-ever election
geopolitical_news.summary: Lourenco secures a second term in August with the ruling party's narrowest margin since 1992.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dos Santos dies in Barcelona
geopolitical_news.summary: The former president, who ruled for 38 years, dies in July aged 79.

sport.headline: Angola exit AFCON at group stage
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras go home early from the Cameroon tournament in January.

geopolitical_news.headline: Angola quits OPEC
geopolitical_news.summary: Luanda announces its exit from the oil cartel in December over production quotas.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition disputes Lourenco's mandate
geopolitical_news.summary: UNITA continues to reject the 2022 results as the economy stagnates.

sport.headline: Angola qualify for 2023 AFCON
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras top their qualifying group to reach the Ivory Coast finals.

geopolitical_news.headline: Angola mediates DRC-Rwanda talks
geopolitical_news.summary: Lourenco hosts the Luanda process aimed at easing tensions over eastern Congo.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fuel subsidy cuts spark protests
geopolitical_news.summary: Rising pump prices trigger sporadic demonstrations in Luanda.

sport.headline: Angola reach AFCON quarterfinals
sport.summary: A 1-0 defeat to Nigeria in February ends Angola's best AFCON run since 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: Angola chairs the African Union
geopolitical_news.summary: Lourenco takes the rotating AU chairmanship in February.

geopolitical_news.headline: Angola marks 50 years of independence
geopolitical_news.summary: November celebrations commemorate half a century since independence from Portugal.

sport.headline: Angola qualify for 2025 AFCON
sport.summary: The Palancas Negras top their qualifying group to reach the Morocco tournament.
